The '''2026 Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council election''' took place on 7 May 2026 to elect members of [[Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council]] in [[Lancashire]], [[England]].<ref>{{Cite web|first= |last= |author-link= |first2= |last2= |author2-link= |url=https://mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk/2026/02/16/update-on-may-2026-local-authority-elections/ |website=mhclmedia.blog.gov.uk |title=Update on May 2026 local authority elections |pages= |date=16 February 2026 |access-date=16 February 2026 |work= |publisher=Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government |place= |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260216154427/https://mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk/2026/02/16/update-on-may-2026-local-authority-elections/ |archive-date=16 February 2026 }}</ref> This was on the same day as other [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|local elections]].
